files..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "name": "study-latex",
  "displayName": "Study LaTeX",
  "version": "2.1.0",
  "description": "Fills the gaps in the Claude desktop app's own math in the Code tab: rewrites \\[...\\], environments written without dollars and one-line $$...$$ into forms the app draws, tells Claude how to write math, and on Windows with MiKTeX compiles TikZ figures; built for students who study with Claude. A fork of zaahiral/claude-latex 0.5.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "yeonwooook"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/yeonwooook/claude-study-latex",
  "repository": "https://github.com/yeonwooook/claude-study-latex",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "latex",
    "math",
    "katex",
    "tikz",
    "study",
    "engineering",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "colorScheme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Figure color",
      "description": "The ink of TikZ figures. auto follows the system light or dark setting. Pick light or dark if the app's theme differs from the system's.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "light",
        "dark"
      ]
    },
    "compileBlocks": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Compile TikZ blocks (Windows, MiKTeX)",
      "description": "Off by default. On, ```tikz code blocks in replies are compiled into figures with your local MiKTeX (latex and dvisvgm). Read the README's safety section before turning it on.",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
